input:
CURRENT SCENE:
发现有的植物对身体非常好，特别是茶，让肚子感觉又暖和又清楚。他告诉朋友：“你吃哪种植物，这就要看你的口味。比方说，你爱吃甜的，可能喜欢糖。”他最喜欢吃花，除了夹竹桃以外，什么都花想吃。

ITEMS:

[I240] 让肚子感觉又暖和又【清楚】   correction: 清楚 → 舒服   strength: error
  checker's note: 清楚 cannot describe how the stomach feels
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 神农的肚子[最好→好了]以后
  her past correction: 所以⟦他一吃，肚子就疼死了⟧ — her note: it is problematic in coherence, if 灵芝is medicine, it should not be他一吃肚子就疼死了
  her past correction: 特别是[肚子疼→肚子，很疼]

[I241] 这就要【看】你的口味   correction: 看 → 看到   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 看 -> 看到 (corrected 37/71 in train)
  rule card (perception_look_see, Vocabulary): 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the person actually sees/catches sight of <thing or situation>, so use 看到, not 看.  Her terms: 看look vs.看到see, no了, 看look, 看到see
  her past correction: 所以他[看→看到]什么就吃什么 — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  her past correction: 她[一看这→一看到这样] — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  her past correction: 他一[看→看到]花 — her note: 看look vs.看到see

[I242] 【可能】喜欢糖   correction: 可能 → ，这样可以   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 可能 -> ，这样可以 (corrected 9/14 in train)
  rule card (loose_clause_connection, Coherence: connectors): Make the relationship between clauses or sentences clear. Add or choose a connector, a purpose phrase, or a sequence marker that shows the real connection.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: use <connector/purpose/sequence phrase> to show how this sentence connects to the previous clause or sentence.
  her past correction: 一点儿甜[+，也]一点儿咸
  her past correction: 所以我们[可能→可以]住在家安静
  her past correction: [可能是毒的→可能有毒]

[I243] 什么【都花】想吃   correction: 都花 → 花都   strength: error
  checker's note: 什么花都想吃 is the required word order
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 他吃[+了]一片花瓣 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 他[+在山上]吃一个香香的花 — her note: “所以” is inappropriate because here is not a result, delete it, add “在山上”
  her past correction: 他[吃→吃了]一个香香的花 — her note: 了completed

items.explanation: 清楚 describes whether something is clear, not how the stomach feels. Use 舒服 for a warm, comfortable stomach feeling.
Use 看到see when the person actually sees something, rather than 看look. Here use 看到, not 看.
Use ，这样可以 to make the connection with the previous clause clear.
With 什么, put 花 before 都: 什么花都想吃. This word order means “want to eat every kind of flower.”
